related.title: 相變材料蓄熱模組設計
related.titleEn: Phase Change Material Thermal Storage Modules
related.transfer: 可遷移「顯熱蓄熱量」與「移轉電量的電費節省」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；相變材料蓄熱模組設計的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Sensible heat storage" and "Energy cost saved by shifting" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Phase Change Material Thermal Storage Modules must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦夜裡製冰、白天融冰：潛熱蓄冷、製冰的效率代價、電費與需量、主機縮小與電網效益；相變材料蓄熱模組設計則以在固定的溫度存熱與放熱：潛熱與顯熱、熔化時間、鰭片間距、膨脹、循環穩定性與儲熱密度為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on making ice at night and melting it by day: latent cold storage, the efficiency cost of ice-making, energy and demand charges, smaller chillers and benefit to the grid; Phase Change Material Thermal Storage Modules centres on storing and releasing heat at a fixed temperature: latent against sensible heat, melting time, fin spacing, expansion, cycling stability and storage density, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「潛熱蓄能」與「潛熱蓄能」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「移峰與熱泵的電力槓桿」的模型移到相變材料蓄熱模組設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「熔化時的體積膨脹」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Latent heat storage" and "Latent heat storage".
Move the model of "Peak shifting and the leverage of heat pumps" to Phase Change Material Thermal Storage Modules, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Volume expansion on melting", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「顯熱蓄熱量」與「移轉電量的電費節省」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；相變材料蓄熱模組設計的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Sensible heat storage" and "Energy cost saved by shifting" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Phase Change Material Thermal Storage Modules must be respecified.

related.title: 地下含水層季節儲熱
related.transfer: 可遷移「顯熱蓄熱量」與「移轉電量的電費節省」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；地下含水層季節儲熱的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Sensible heat storage" and "Energy cost saved by shifting" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Aquifer Seasonal Thermal Energy Storage must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦夜裡製冰、白天融冰：潛熱蓄冷、製冰的效率代價、電費與需量、主機縮小與電網效益；地下含水層季節儲熱則以把夏天的熱存到冬天、冬天的冷存到夏天：熱半徑、井的洩降、地下水漂移、直接冷卻與冷熱平衡為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on making ice at night and melting it by day: latent cold storage, the efficiency cost of ice-making, energy and demand charges, smaller chillers and benefit to the grid; Aquifer Seasonal Thermal Energy Storage centres on keeping summer heat for winter and winter cold for summer: thermal radius, well drawdown, groundwater drift, free cooling and thermal balance, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「潛熱蓄能」與「顯熱蓄熱量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「移峰與熱泵的電力槓桿」的模型移到地下含水層季節儲熱，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「直接冷卻的效率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Latent heat storage" and "Sensible heat storage".
Move the model of "Peak shifting and the leverage of heat pumps" to Aquifer Seasonal Thermal Energy Storage, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Efficiency of free cooling", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「顯熱蓄熱量」與「移轉電量的電費節省」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；地下含水層季節儲熱的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Sensible heat storage" and "Energy cost saved by shifting" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Aquifer Seasonal Thermal Energy Storage must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 冰水蓄冷與尖峰負載移轉
history.titleEn: Ice Thermal Storage and Peak Load Shifting
history.text: 1980 年儲冰空調開始用於商業大樓；2009 年美國銀行大樓完工啟用；2016 年紐約推動以儲能減少尖峰負載的計畫。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1980: Ice storage began to be used in commercial buildings. 2009: The Bank of America Tower was completed. 2016: New York launched programmes to cut peak load with storage. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
